requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Cause number, in paragraph 2 of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Cause number, in paragraph 2 of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case identifier is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the cause number, from the sentencing court's docket

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Every conviction on the record with offence, class, court and date, in paragraph 3 of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Every conviction on the record with offence, class, court and date, in paragraph 3 of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform never sees the participant's criminal history
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: every conviction on your record - offence, class, court and date - from your own Washington State Patrol criminal history record

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: The conviction and its exact RCW or municipal ordinance, in paragraph 2 of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: The conviction and its exact RCW or municipal ordinance, in paragraph 2 of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no conviction fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: what you were convicted of and the exact RCW or municipal ordinance, worded as the court record words it - the sentencing court's docket supplies it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: The legal financial obligation position stated in paragraph 5 of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: The legal financial obligation position stated in paragraph 5 of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no financial-obligation fact is held; the clerk or collections agency states the current position
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: which of the three RCW 9.97.010(1)(b) positions is yours - paid in full, fully compliant with a plan, or good cause established with the court - from the clerk's or collections agency's current figures

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: The applicant's statement in paragraph 6 that none of the RCW 9.97.010(1)(c) bars applies
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: The applicant's statement in paragraph 6 that none of the RCW 9.97.010(1)(c) bars applies
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the memo's manual-completion record places this statement with the participant because it rests on the whole conviction history, which the platform never sees
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: your own statement, written after reading your complete criminal history record, that none of the bars applies - it rests on your whole history, which this packet never sees

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Any other name the case was filed under, in paragraph 2 of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Any other name the case was filed under, in paragraph 2 of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.why: what names the case was filed under is on the record, not in the platform
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: any other name the case was filed under, from the court record, or NONE

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: The qualified county named in the caption of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: The qualified county named in the caption of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.why: which county is the county of conviction lives on a record the platform has not seen, and the residence-versus-conviction choice is the participant's own
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the qualified county you are filing in - this packet routes to the county of your conviction or adjudication, whose superior court may not decline; the county where you live is also qualified but may decline, as the filing instructions explain

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Sentencing date, release date and supervision end date, in paragraph 2 of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Sentencing date, release date and supervision end date, in paragraph 2 of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no sentencing fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the sentencing date, the date of release from any confinement, and the date any supervision or probation ended, from the sentencing court's docket - every waiting period runs from one of these

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: The point on the RCW 9.97.010(1)(a) scale that applies, and the date it is computed from, in paragraph 4 of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: The point on the RCW 9.97.010(1)(a) scale that applies, and the date it is computed from, in paragraph 4 of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the scale point turns on sentence type and dates the platform does not hold
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: which point on the graduated scale applies to you, and the date it is computed from, worked out from the docket dates as the filing instructions explain

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: The court that imposed the sentence, in paragraph 2 of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: The court that imposed the sentence, in paragraph 2 of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the sentencing court - district, municipal or superior - and its county or city, from your court paperwork

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: The county named in the caption of the proposed order
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: The county named in the caption of the proposed order
requiredBeforeFiling.why: which county the petition is filed in is the participant's answer, not a held fact
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the same qualified county as the petition

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: The prosecuting attorney of the county where the certificate is sought, named in the notice
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: The prosecuting attorney of the county where the certificate is sought, named in the notice
requiredBeforeFiling.why: which county the applicant files in is the applicant's answer
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the county where you are filing - its prosecuting attorney is the first recipient RCW 9.97.020(6) names

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Each other jurisdiction that sentenced the applicant in the five years preceding the application, listed in the notice
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Each other jurisdiction that sentenced the applicant in the five years preceding the application, listed in the notice
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the five-year sentencing history lives on records the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: every other jurisdiction that sentenced you in the last five years, from your own criminal history record, or NONE
